proof_scope: Subgeodesic convexity, noncollapsed minimum, L1 and quasi-everywhere endpoint continuity; operations/pasting and product/slice upper envelopes; relative full-mass Perron existence, restriction, endpoint/decreasing/order calculus and rooftop Legendre formula. Ordinary unbounded maximal psh functions have zero local non-pluripolar top measure by internal bounded balayage and weighted capacity continuity. Rotation symmetrization proves Perron local maximality. Compact extension, internal IBP and exact fibre formula give affine relative energy, then decreasing truncations extend to E1.
